commit.message:
fix(server + client): incorrect inferred input type when using standalone middleware (#4973)

* fix #4972: incorrect inferred input type when using standalone middlewares

The previous fix fixed _input_out which resolved the incorrect types on the
server side when defining the procedure, but still had incorrect _input_in
types, which clients use.

Similar fix as before: do a merge of the _input_in types similarly as with
_input_out.

* Explicitly call procedure in #4947 regression test to verify inputs

* Remove unnecessary UnsetMarker usages

These are not necessary to make input merging with
experimental_standaloneMiddleware work and were added
erroneously before. Removing them gets rid of unnecessary
typescript compiler work.

* Fix formatting issues

* Modify test to test public API types, not private types
